AGENTS.md_additions.purpose: Extend JWRS with a predefined catalog of structured effect records and operational bindings, matching AGENTS.md's definition-and-example organization.

definitions.effect_dimension: An independently observable aspect of an operation; dimensions compose rather than replace one another.
definitions.instruction_description: Authoring prose that defines a field or procedure; permitted in this governing module.
definitions.runtime_record: Closed structured data without explanatory prose or evaluatory compliance keys.
definitions.evidence_ref: An actual invocation or returned record reference; if unavailable, null. It is not a invented ID with an official-looking prefix.
definitions.local_record_id: A locally assigned reference for connecting records; it does not by itself establish external provenance.
definitions.unknown: No obtainable observation supports a field value; represented by null where the schema permits.
definitions.illustrative_record: Example data prefixed EXAMPLE or explicitly described as a placeholder; never actual execution evidence.
definitions.source_literal: Verbatim source data. Natural-language source quotes are allowed because they are evidence operands rather than explanatory responses.

AGENTS.md_additions.governing_rule: Use this fixed catalog. Populate factual fields from source records. The executor may bind operands but must not invent or relax record schemas, convert missing evidence into assurance, or replace a required mechanism with equivalent-looking state.

phase_contract.rule: Observed records are populated only after actual observation. Earlier phase records are not evidence that later execution occurred. Use empty arrays for no records and null only for unavailable scalar fields; known JSON null may also be an observed value, distinguished by its evidence envelope.

cross_scenario_rules: Descriptions and explanations belong to instruction and examples, not runtime factual records.
Known source literals and raw errors may contain prose; they remain source data, not self-evaluation.
Do not fabricate a missing identifier, timestamp, digest, invocation, or producer link.
Preserve returned provider values; do not coerce job conclusions into invented exit codes.
No-op and attempted mutation are represented by different call and observation records.
Requested scope determines which dimensions are required; this catalog does not authorize new side effects.
Cross-record references must resolve; this cannot be established by JSON syntax validation alone.
Semantic correctness and interpretation fidelity remain outside what these operational observations alone establish.

integration_notes.placement: Attach effect_catalog, operational_additions, fixed schemas, and definitions under the existing governing instruction, preserving its selectors and output contract.
integration_notes.runtime_extension: Add the defined record arrays to the selected projection/result schemas through an author-approved revision, not executor improvisation.
integration_notes.activation: This draft does not modify or activate the authoritative instruction.
integration_notes.unsupported_effects: A future catalog revision must define unsupported effects; the executor cannot create ad hoc truth schemas.

AGENTS.md_additions.completion_rule: Populate the required fixed records and report outstanding operation IDs. Do not infer completion from populated schemas, example similarity, or process exit alone.
